slides.title: 5 warehouse KPIs to *read* before 9 AM
slides.body: Lead the day, don't just review it

slides.title: Dock-to-stock *time*
bullets: Hours from truck unloaded to stock pickable
Slow put-away is stock you own but can't sell
Chase the oldest pallet still on the dock

slides.title: Pick accuracy, by *line*
bullets: Check at staging, not from complaints

slides.title: Cases per labour *hour*
bullets: Cases moved ÷ hours worked on the floor
Compare shift to shift, not site to site
A drop usually means waiting, not slow people

slides.title: Truck turnaround *time*
bullets: Gate in to gate out, per vehicle
Long turnaround means fewer trips per truck

slides.title: Stock near *expiry*
bullets: Act this week: push, transfer or promote

slides.title: Five numbers, one board, *every* morning
slides.body: Save this for your next review.
